summary: Alibaba Group filed a Form 6-K containing notice of its annual general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting is set for September 22, 2026, with proposals including a share issuance mandate (up to 10% of issued shares) and a share repurchase mandate. These are routine governance matters for shareholder approval, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard AGM notice equivalent to a proxy statement under US rules, with no deal terms or material event to analyze.
